item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offers free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying residents in Martin County.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home after nearly 2 years following structural damage in St. Lucie County
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of displacement from their condos. item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts finish top 15 at nationals, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals. The defending champions will face Spain in the final Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Spain advances to first World Cup final since 2010 with 2-0 win over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain defeated France 2-0 Tuesday. Spain will face either Argentina or England in the final Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Atlanta increases security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal match
item.description: Atlanta police will increase personnel and resources for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal. The matchup is considered one of the tournament's highest-risk games because of longstanding tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Police investigate death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams
item.description: Cape Town police are investigating the death of 25-year-old South Africa World Cup soccer player Jayden Adams. His body was discovered Saturday at a property in Cape Town.

item.title: England and Argentina renew fierce World Cup rivalry in semifinal
item.description: England and Argentina meet in the World Cup semifinals Wednesday in Atlanta. The winner will play Spain in the final Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with four highest-ranked teams advancing
item.description: The World Cup final four features England, Argentina, France and Spain. Despite underdog success stories and surprise results, the four highest-ranked teams reached the semifinals.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed and reburied without consent
item.description: Adam Chrzan and Tanya Crovo allege their infant son's remains were disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge.
